name: Sol Next

author.name: Zhang Chongyang (许昌北海医院张重阳)

highlights: 100% Native Android Material 3 Dual-Mode UI (Chat | Task) in Light (#FFFFFF) and Obsidian Dark (#0E0F11) at 120Hz
Zero-config built-in DeepSeek Flash & Brave Search real-time web grounding sealed in Rust ChaCha20+HMAC-SHA256 vault
Bundled 4-stage on-device realtime neural voice stack (GTCRN + Silero VAD v5 + Zipformer-CTC + AISHELL-3 VITS) with zero cloud voice API needed
Hands-free Notification Voice Readout for driving and resting with Audio Ducking and automatic OTP/financial privacy redaction
Free universal login component (Phone OTP, Email OTP, Google, WeChat, QQ, Apple, GitHub, Huawei/Feishu) + Subscription OAuth model login (OpenRouter PKCE, GitHub Models)
Background Independent Virtual Screen with DISPLAY_IME_POLICY_HIDE keyboard isolation, live steering, and OEM Accessibility self-healing

faq.q: Is Sol Next free and open-source?
faq.a: Yes. Sol Next is Apache-2.0 open-source, completely free, and ships with built-in DeepSeek Flash, Brave Search, and 4-stage on-device neural voice out of the box.

faq.q: Does Sol Next require cloud voice API keys for Live Voice or AI Phone Calls?
faq.a: No. Sol Next bundles GTCRN denoiser, Silero VAD v5, Zipformer-CTC ASR, and AISHELL-3 VITS TTS directly inside the APK.

faq.q: Can Sol Next read notifications aloud safely while driving?
faq.a: Yes. Notification Voice Readout uses offline on-device TTS with Audio Ducking, automatically redacts OTP verification codes and sensitive financial digits by default, and supports Bluetooth/headset-only mode.

faq.q: Does Sol Next repeatedly prompt for Accessibility permission after closing the app on Chinese Android ROMs?
faq.a: No. v9.1.2 persists one-time onboarding completion and silently self-heals Accessibility in 200ms when Shell Helper is connected.
